summary: Verified 2FA bug fix (QR generation 500) end-to-end. Backend pytest 4/4 passed; UI flow passed (SETUP returned 200 with data:image/png;base64 QR, enable with valid TOTP, disable with valid TOTP, invalid code returns 400). No 500 at any step. 2FA left disabled.
critical_code_review_comments: 2fa disable endpoint silently returns success when 2FA is already disabled (status True + 'не активна'). Minor: consider 400 for consistency.
No endpoint to force-disable 2FA from superadmin without OTP. If a user loses their authenticator, they're locked out. Consider admin reset path.
server.py is 2419 lines — well above the 700-line guideline; should be split into feature routers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: QR generation now works via Pillow PNG (verified prefix data:image/png;base64,...). SVG fallback not exercised because Pillow 12.3.0 is installed. If Pillow is removed, the fallback should also be tested. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_2fa_flow.py is self-contained and reusable (reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or /app/frontend/.env).
rca of the issue: Original 500 at /api/security/2fa/setup was raised when qrcode.make().save(buf, format='PNG') hit a missing Pillow. Fix wraps PNG generation in try/except and falls back to pure-Python SVG via qrcode.image.svg.SvgImage. requirements.txt pins qrcode[pil]>=7.4.2 so Pillow is installed by default. Verified at runtime: PIL 12.3.0 present, SETUP returns data:image/png;base64,... which renders. Mitigation: no further action needed.
